title: Cascades price hikes align with ‘reality of the economy,’ CEO says
summary: Fresh off a new containerboard price hike, the Canadian fiber producer’s executives explained what’s behind the move. They also laid out expected effects from new tariffs that the United States announced in July.

title: WK Kellogg ahead of schedule for cutting BHT in cereal packaging
summary: This comes as the U.S. FDA reassesses the safety of the food preservative. Kellogg also plans to cut artificial dyes in all cereals by year's end.

title: Packaging M&A activity dips in 2026
summary: Economic uncertainty has contributed to “cautious buyer behavior” resulting in a more than 21% decrease in packaging M&A activity through the second quarter, according to a Capstone Partners report.

title: Where Walmart’s packaging ended up on 2025 sustainability targets
summary: The retailer noted “trade-offs among product protection, food safety, cost, regulatory requirements, recycled material availability, evolving supplier portfolios” and more.

title: Sonoco names global consumer packaging leader amid restructuring
summary: The company is melding two geographically oriented consumer packaging business units into one just months after announcing the dual structure.

title: International Paper, Niagara Bottling announced closures in July
summary: Texas and Illinois are two of the states where shutdowns are planned by packaging-related companies.

title: GPI lowers guidance, aims for $85M in 2026 cost cuts
summary: Price increases and additional headcount reductions are among the strategies to recoup inflation costs, executives said. They also described what’s behind the decision to re-enter the URB market.

title: Ball starting cans production at new Oregon facility
summary: CEO Ron Lewis weighed in on recent tariff changes and executives discussed capacity expansions that could aid a tight market.

title: California film recycling pilots make case for commercial collection
summary: The pilots, launched by the Flexible Film Recycling Alliance, aim to get more film packaging found in warehouses and retail backrooms into the recycling stream. Shorr Packaging and 1-800-Got-Junk are partners.

title: Containerboard production healthier in Q2, but still in decline
summary: Data from the American Forest & Paper Association shows improving demand and operating rates for containerboard producers, aligning with companies’ recent earnings commentaries.

title: Casella Q2 benefits from landfill volumes, acquisition rollover
summary: Third-party landfill tons gave the company a boost in the capacity-constrained capacity-constrained Northeast, and it’s steadily working to integrate its mid-Atlantic assets. But high fuel costs and lower collection volumes were headwinds in Q2.

title: Republic Services boosts guidance amid improving commodities
summary: The company is seeing positive signs in several underlying dynamics, including commercial construction activity. Other growth intiatives, including polymer centers and PFAS-related business, are also netting returns.

title: What’s next as Hawai’i enacts clean fuels program; Biogas news from Waga, Convertus
summary: The state’s governor signed a law that creates a clean fuel standard by 2028. Other biogas news include a Waga Energy and Casella Waste Systems project, a Redtail Renewables deal and Convertus project financing.

title: How Miami-Dade County plans to tackle zero waste by 2040
summary: County officials shared behind-the-scenes details with Waste Dive on Miami-Dade's approach to improving recycling and organics diversion, as well as partnerships with businesses and community groups.

title: BP to sell landfill RNG business Archaea Energy
summary: The energy major announced it’s marketing Archaea amid a strategic pivot to streamline its business. BP’s $4.1 billion acquisition of Archaea four years ago stands as a high water mark in the RNG industry.

title: Otto, holder of NYC Bin contract, is in involuntary bankruptcy
summary: The binmaker based in North Carolina was placed in Chapter 7 proceedings by a court this summer due to outstanding debts. Questions now swirl about the company’s assets as dozens of creditors were revealed in new documents.

title: Arcwood Environmental announces sixth deal since rebrand
summary: The environmental services provider announced another mid-Atlantic acquisition, this time for a company specializing in hazardous and regulated medical waste management.

title: Connecticut beverage container redemption rate soared in 2025
summary: Connecticut’s rate continues to climb after implementing a major bottle bill overhaul a few years ago. Other states saw rates fall, but new laws in places like Maine and Vermont could spell improvements in coming years.

title: Waste Connections sues LA County for $825M over Chiquita Canyon closure

title: WM expands autonomous equipment plans at Arizona landfill
summary: WM is running an autonomous bulldozer at the Marana landfill in partnership with Caterpillar and will now add other kinds of remote-controlled equipment. It’s a first for the industry and a way to make operations safer.
